description: Transform your project schedule into a live Critical Path Network Diagram inside Power BI. The visual automatically identifies your critical path, color-codes activities by schedule risk, and lets you explore dependencies interactively — no external tools needed. KEY FEATURES - Automatic critical path detection with animated edges - Color-coded nodes — Critical, Near-Critical, Safe, and Completed - Phase swim-lanes for WBS grouping - Cross-filtering with all visuals on the page - Pan, zoom, and auto-fit navigation - Rich configurable tooltips - Fully customizable fonts, colors, and node styles - Positionable legend with independent font controls IDEAL FOR Project Managers, Project Controls Engineers, PMO teams, and anyone managing schedules in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project who needs schedule risk visibility in Power BI. REQUIREMENTS Power BI Desktop or Service. Activity data with unique IDs, predecessor relationships, and total float values.
